semantics: Multiplicative replaces f with factor*f. Truncated_shift defines f_policy=f+clip(mu+delta,lower,upper)-mu, mu=E[f] under preceding interventions. This population-mean-targeting shift preserves parent effects and innovations; realized outcomes need not satisfy the bounds.
